name: appshell-slot-composition
proves: registered app-shell with authored content slot fill; navigation/active/responsive from the EXISTING composition semantics (no new navigation contract)

composition.note: UiApplicationComposition semantics: desktop arrangement + drawer below the navigationAt breakpoint; UiShellLink.current resolved by the renderer/adapter from the matched route (route ids stay with the renderer)

expected: authored content renders inside the shell in editor canvas and finished app identically; active navigation highlight and responsive collapse come from the composition + route matching (matchMedia 720/960 behavior already implemented in AppShell.svelte); no shell outputs are required for this proof
